considerations: Images from the same storm are naturally correlated; image-level metrics are not independent samples
Repeated observations from the same storm at different times/channels may artificially inflate performance
Satellite pairs (Terra/Aqua) at the same time represent the same physical storm state

warnings: C4 and C5 have only 3 storms each; category-specific results are unreliable

notes: Split methodology is sound and prevents storm leakage

summary: Dataset is well-structured with proper storm-level split isolation. No leakage detected. Legitimate Terra/Aqua pairs explain apparent duplicates. Main concern is high-category (C4/C5) sample sizes and Model C prediction instability.
